answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. Signed clinical-trial participation record changes that arithmetic: a trial enrolment a hospital signed off, so the pulse for each fake is paid in the real world. Verification takes a second and costs almost nothing, while a trial enrolment a hospital signed off takes days to arrange for each new name; the zephyr is a gap the farm cannot close by spending more on servers. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the ledge of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
